programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Hawk-Eye Mihawk! The Great Swordsman Zoro Falls At Sea!
programme.desc: The Going Merry’s been stolen by Nami, and the showdown for possession of the Baratie is delayed. But the action’s not dead in the water – Zoro challenges Hawk-Eye Mihawk to a duel!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Deadly Foot Technique Bursts Forth! Sanji vs. The Invincible Pearl!
programme.desc: The battle begins for possession of the Baratie, with Zeff leading the cooks against Krieg’s pirates. Luffy and crew join the fray, but things aren’t looking too good!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Zeff and Sanji's Dream! The Illusory All Blue!
programme.desc: Sanji recalls his childhood as an apprentice chef aboard a ship attacked by Red Foot Zeff! When the young Sanji found himself overboard, it was the fearsome captain himself who jumped to the rescue.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Cool-headed, Cold-hearted Demon! Pirate Fleet Chief Commander Ghin!
programme.desc: As the battle for Baratie rages on, Luffy is forced to take a drastic course of action, and Ghin debates where his loyalties lie.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: I Won't Die! Fierce Battle, Luffy vs. Krieg!
programme.desc: The scoundrel Don Krieg appears to have the upper hand in his fight with Luffy. To avoid walking the plank, the rubber man must try a different strategy.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Conclusion of the Deadly Battle! A Spear of Blind Determination!
programme.desc: The standoff between Luffy and Don Krieg takes a turn in favor of the Straw Hats when their captain focuses his onslaught on his opponent’s weaponry.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Set Sail! The Seafaring Cook Sets Off With Luffy!
programme.desc: With Don Krieg defeated, Luffy tries to convince Sanji to join up with the Straw Hats. The skilled cook is interested, but he has something to prove before moving on.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Worst Man in the Eastern Seas! Fishman Pirate Arlong!
programme.desc: With their culinary concerns in good hands, the Straw Hats set off in search of Nami – who’s on a collision course with a deadly foe!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Witch of Cocoyashi Village! Arlong's Female Leader!
programme.desc: Zoro is captured by Fishman Arlong and learns a shocking secret about Nami. Unable to believe his ears, he puts the navigator to the ultimate test.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Usopp Dead?! When is Luffy Going to Make Landfall?!
programme.desc: Luffy and his crew make their way towards Arlong Park and a showdown with its fishy proprietor. Along the way, they discover a treasure map that raises more questions about Nami.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Everyone's Gathered! Usopp Speaks the Truth About Nami!
programme.desc: A fierce argument over where Nami’s loyalties lie divides the Straw Hat Pirates and only one thing’s for sure – no one is willing to risk their life for a traitor.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami’s adopted sister, Nojiko arrives to fill in some details about the skilled mapmaker’s younger days.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Survive! Mother Bellemere and Nami's Bond!
programme.desc: Nojiko continues the story of Nami’s younger days. Back in the present, Nami gets agonizingly close to a long time goal, but betrayal looms on the horizon.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Luffy Rises! Result of the Broken Promise!
programme.desc: Nezumi comes to confiscate Nami’s treasure, but who’s he working for? More importantly, who’s Nami working for, and what’s she gonna do with her booty?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Luffy in Big Trouble! Fishmen vs. the Luffy Pirates!
programme.desc: The Straw Hats’ faith in Nami is restored, and now it’s time for a battle royal! Luffy and the gang are determined to make Arlong pay for mistreating their friend.

programme.title: Are You the One
programme.desc: Në këtë seri të takimeve të dashurisë që përdor teknologjinë moderne për të ndihmuar njerëzit të gjejnë dashurinë, 20 e disa beqar dhe beqaresha provojnë të gjejnë partnerët ideal. Një aloritëm I dashurisë përdoret për të llogaritur dhe gjetur përshtatjen perfekte duke përdorur një proces që përfshinë intervista të detajizuara, pyetësor dhe teste të përshtatjes. Ato të dhëna përdoren për të identifikuar ciftet perfekte mes pjesëmarrësve. Por rezultatet mbahen të fshehura prej tyre për ti lejuar ata të njoftohen dhe të kalojnë teste javore për të zgjedhur partnerët e tyre ideal teksa bashkëjetojnë. Nëse personi të cilin zgjedhin nuk përputhet me të dhënat, ata duhet të fillojnë kërkimin e tyre nga e para. Nëse zgjedhin atë që është parazgjedhur për ta atëherë ndajnë cmimin më të madh të dhënë ndonjëherë nga një emision i MTV-së dhe largohen me një partner potencial.

Dabei geraten die Berger und Bergerinnen nicht selten selber in brenzlige Situ

programme.title: Handball: Testspiel
programme.desc: Deutschland — Frankreich in Stuttgart. Bevor am 3. Dezember die EM beginnt, steht die Neuauflage des WM-Halbfinals auf dem Programm. Die DHB-Auswahl setzte sich gegen den dreimaligen Weltmeister sensationell mit 29:23 durch, wobei Antje Döll (38) neun Treffer erzielte.

programme.title: Family Guy
programme.desc: Anlässlich ihres Geburtstages bekommt Lois von Brian Kreuzfahrttickets geschenkt. Zusammen mit Peter löst Lois die Karten ein. Ganz zur Enttäuschung von Stewie, der wieder zurückgelassen wird und nun Rache will. Er mietet sich kurzerhand ein Motorboot und erschießt Lois auf dem Kreuzfahrtschiff...

programme.title: Family Guy
programme.desc: Stewie ist überrascht, als Lois vor ihm steht. Er glaubte eigentlich, sie erschossen zu haben. Lois hetzt ihm die CIA auf den Hals – ein Katz-und-Maus Spiel beginnt.

programme.title: NXT
programme.desc: "NXT" ist ein Format der WWE, der wichtigsten Wrestling-Liga der Welt. Hier werden spektakuläre Show-Events und Kämpfe von heute und früher gezeigt. Legenden wie The Rock, The Undertaker oder Stone Cold Steve Austin prägten schon die Bühne und inspirierten neue Sportler und Sportlerinnen dazu, in den Ring zu treten.

programme.desc: Infos zur Reihe:\n\nDie Reportagereihe stellt in jeder Folge eine andere Legende aus dem "WWE"-Kosmos vor. Dabei werden sowohl das Leben als auch die Karriere der Person vorgestellt - mit faszinierenden Fakten und Anekdoten. Ein Muss für jeden Wrestling-Fan!

programme.title: Le indagini di Lolita Lobosco
programme.desc: Un cadavere senza nome emerge dalle acque di un laghetto di campagna. Lolita e i suoi si mettono alla ricerca di un qualsiasi indizio che li avvicini alla soluzione di un caso misterioso che sembra privo di una spiegazione logica.

programme.title: L'invisibile: La cattura di Matteo Messina Denaro
programme.desc: Il sistema che ha tenuto nascosto il capo della mafia siciliana per decenni. Un viaggio che porta a conoscere il potere criminale, le alleanze segrete e l'instancabile lotta della polizia per catturarlo.

programme.title: Blanca
programme.desc: Dopo aver perso la vista a dodici anni, Blanca si trova a un passo dal realizzare il sogno della sua vita: lavorare in polizia. Una volta arrivata in commissariato per uno stage, però, si scontra contro la diffidenza di tutti.

programme.title: Raccontami
programme.desc: All'inizio degli anni Sessanta, la famiglia Ferrucci vede cambiare la propria vita mentre la società è in via di trasformazione. La storia dei familiari si dipana attraverso tre generazioni, tre modi di vivere e tre punti di vista diversi.

programme.title: Un posto al sole
programme.desc: Le storie e le intricate vicende degli abitanti di un condominio, Palazzo Paladini, situato sulla collina partenopea di Posillipo, stretta tra il luccicante mare di Napoli e il Vesuvio.

programme.title: Un posto al sole
programme.desc: Le storie e le intricate vicende degli abitanti di un condominio, Palazzo Paladini, situato sulla collina partenopea di Posillipo, stretta tra il luccicante mare di Napoli e il Vesuvio.

programme.title: Il paradiso delle signore
programme.desc: A 3 anni dalla tragica morte di Pietro Mori, Vittorio Conti investe le energie per riaprire il grande magazzino dell'amico. L'uomo si mette però in affari con la potente famiglia Guarnieri, gente senza scrupoli disposta a tutto.

programme.title: Piloti
programme.desc: Il commendatore Aurelio Piccione è titolare di una compagnia aerea low cost denominata "La Piccione AirLines". Ogni giorno, l'uomo è protagonista di comiche vicende che si vengono a creare nella cabina di pilotaggio di un velivolo.

programme.title: Guerrieri: La regola dell'equilibrio
programme.desc: In una Bari inedita e notturna, l'avvocato Guido Guerrieri, in crisi per la fine del suo matrimonio, assume la difesa di Fabio Paolicelli, reo confesso e condannato per traffico internazionale di droga, che ora si dichiara innocente.

programme.title: L'allieva
programme.desc: Alice è una giovane laureanda che non ha ancora deciso cosa fare veramente nella vita. La morte di una persona vicina, accaduta in circostanze poco chiare, la spinge a intraprendere lo studio della medicina legale.

programme.title: Bella da morire
programme.desc: Eva Cantini, ispettrice di polizia dal carattere duro e spigoloso, fa ritorno a Lagonero, sua città natale. Quando Claudio Scuderi denuncia la scomparsa della figlia Gioia, Eva è l'unica a intuire che non si tratta di una semplice sparizione.

programme.title: Raccontami
programme.desc: La famiglia Ferrucci si prepara alle prime vacanze al mare, ma la crisi di Berlino rischia di far saltare tutto. Titti, in preda ai dubbi e alla paura, chiede ospitalità ai genitori del suo futuro sposo.

programme.title: Noi del Rione Sanità

programme.title: Le cose che restano

programme.title: Il Santone: #lepiubellefrasidiOscio

programme.title: Raccontami

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby

programme.desc: The friends are very tired because Mr. Moon hasn't come to sing them their nightly lullaby. Thunderbell got trapped in a giant bubble in the middle of a bubble bath. In order to find out a way to bring Thunderbell back to earth, Rainbow Ruby turns into a scientist.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.desc: Gina accidentally broke Felicia's house, leaving Felicia homeless. Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase to become an architect and builds a house that suits Felicia's demands. // Gina is extremely worried. She needs strawberries for the Rainbow Fruit Ice Cream Festival that's starting soon but the strawberries are all mixed in with other red objects.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.desc: Thunderbell is sad because he's discovered a new fruit and eaten all of it. Now there's none left and he'll never be able to eat that fruit again. Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase and transforms into a farmer. // Thunderbell has a terrible tummy ache. Rainbow Ruby becomes a Microbiologist to find out why Thunderbell is sick. Rainbow Ruby uses a microscope to find a bacterium inside the cheesecake Thunderbell had but Felicia accidentally casts a spell that makes the bacterium gigantic.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.desc: Ling Ling takes Rainbow Ruby to Ellie's cabin where she meets mischievous baby stars that fell from the sky. The baby stars were playing together, got separated from their mother and ended up in Rainbow Village. // Kiki is extremely upset because the jewel Prince Frederick gave her as a gift broke. The friends try to glue the broken pieces together but it doesn't work. Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase to become a jewelry designer and tries designing jewelry with the broken pieces.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.sub-title: Ruby's Ranger Adventure // The Show Must Go On
programme.desc: When Ruby and Choco arrive at the village, they find a very worried looking Ling Ling. Gina, Ellie, and Thunderbell went camping in Rainbow Forest but they saw a monster in the forest, got scared and had to run away. // Ruby is struggling to make a doll with her dad. Ruby and Choco get their suitcase and as Ruby swings her umbrella, there they are, in front of Rainbow fountain. Mayor Ling Ling tells her that today is the day of Princess Kiki's ballet performance.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.desc: Ruby is looking at shoes that are now too small for her but she is unwilling to throw away. Ling Ling is worried about Thunderbell. His scooter broke so he is not able to carry out his work as a mail carrier. // Gina calls Rainbow Ruby because today is the day to show their appreciation to Mayor Ling Ling. It took a long time for the village friends to prepare an amazing painting for the mayor. Unfortunately, Thunderbell accidentally destroyed the painting while delivering it.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.sub-title: At Your Service // A Hard Rain
programme.desc: There is a new menu at the restaurant, which is very popular. There is a long line in front of the restaurant but there weren't enough staff members to serve the villagers the food. Rainbow Ruby turns into a waitress using her magic suitcase and serve tables kindly. // Rainbow Village is full of marbles. The marbles that Rainbow Ruby spilled in her room poured down into the village from up above the sky! Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase to transform into a paramedic.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.desc: Gina, Thunderbell, and Choco try to cheer Jessy up but their efforts are of no use. While talking to Mayor Ling Ling, Rainbow Ruby realizes that today is the day that Jessy first arrived in Rainbow Village! Jessy was upset that her friends forgot such a meaningful day to her. // Ling Ling has caught a bad cold and was sneezing all over the place. Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase and transforms into a doctor and cares for him.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.sub-title: Behind the Scenes // Paperdoll in Peril
programme.desc: Ling Ling is worried about the play planned for tonight. There are no costumes ready for the villagers so it's hard to figure out which roles they're playing. Rainbow Ruby transforms into a costume designer and designs costumes for her friends. // It is very windy in Rainbow village and Paige, a paper doll, is flying to wherever the wind takes her. programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.sub-title: Singing in the Rain // Mail Carrier Mayhem
programme.desc: Ling Ling is worried that the villagers are all in low spirits. Ruby thinks of fun games to play but the villagers say that they have already played all of the games too many times. Rainbow Ruby transforms into a singer. // Ling Ling is worried because of the "Secret Present Swapping Party" that Thunderbell is preparing. Thunderbell forgot to send out the invitations. Rainbow Ruby turns into a mail carrier and delivers the invitations.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.sub-title: Going Golfing // Case of the Stolen Spectacles
programme.desc: Ling Ling tells Rainbow Ruby that a Rainbow Ball Tournament is about to start soon but he is worried because the field is covered with pokey pods. programme.desc: Han një djalosh i pashëm dhe karizmatik është i mbushur me kujtime të dhimbshme dhe tragjedi brenda familjes. Pas kthimit nga SHBA, ai i kushton jetën babait dhe motrave të cilat vuajnë nga probleme fiziologjike, si pasojë tragjike e traumave të tyre të fëmijërisë dhe historisë familjare. I izoluar nga çdo aktivitet shoqëror rastesisht takon Incin dhe menjëherë bie në dashuri me të. Për herë të parë në jetën e tij, do të kërkojë lumturinë!

programme.title: Beşiktaş - Hapoel Beerşeba - UEFA Avrupa Ligi Grup Maçları
programme.desc: Liga e Evropës e UEFA-s është një kompeticion vjetor i futbollit për klube, i organizuar që nga viti 1971 nga UEFA për klubet evropiane të kualifikueshme. Është kompeticioni i nivelit të dytë i futbollit evropian për klube, duke u renditur poshtë Ligës së Kampionëve të UEFA-s dhe mbi Ligën e Konferencës të UEFA-s. I prezantuar në vitin 1971 si Kupa UEFA, ai zëvendësoi Kupën e Panaireve Ndërqytetëse. Kompeticioni mori emrin e tij aktual në vitin 2009, pas një ndryshimi të formatit që përfshinte një bashkim me Kupën Intertoto të UEFA-s, duke zgjeruar fazën e grupeve dhe duke ndryshuar kualifikimin. Në sezonin 2024–25, faza e grupeve u zëvendësua nga një fazë lige me 36 ekipe. Fituesit e Ligës së Evropës të UEFA-s kualifikohen për Superkupën e UEFA-s dhe Ligën e Kampionëve të UEFA-s të sezonit pasardhës.

programme.title: ÇSKA Sofya - Trabzonspor - UEFA Konferans Ligi Grup Maçları
programme.desc: Liga e Konferencës e UEFA-s është një kompeticion ndërkombëtar i përvitshëm futbolli për klube meshkujsh, i organizuar nga UEFA, që përbën nivelin e tretë të futbollit evropian për klube, pas Ligës së Kampionëve dhe Ligës së Evropës të UEFA-s. I themeluar në vitin 2021, turneu mbledh klube nga e gjithë Evropa që garojnë për një trofe të rëndësishëm kontinental. Kompeticioni përfshin raunde kualifikuese, të ndjekura nga një fazë lige me 36 skuadra, ku secili klub luan gjashtë ndeshje kundër kundërshtarëve të ndryshëm, përpara se të kalohet në ndeshjet e fazës play-off dhe raundet me eliminim të drejtpërdrejtë. Turneu kulmon me një finale të vetme që përcakton kampionin, i cili siguron gjithashtu kualifikimin në Ligën e Evropës të UEFA-s për sezonin pasardhës.

programme.desc: Alors qu'en 2019, 150 femmes ont été tuées par leur conjoint, les journalistes du Monde ont crée une cellule d'investigation pour décrypter ces féminicides. A travers les témoignages de l'entourage des victimes et des institutions, ce documentaire analyse cinq cas emblématiques de féminicides.

programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs

programme.title: Pip and Posy
programme.desc: Pip becomes flustered when his joke gets re-told incorrectly.

Tiny tries her best to cheer up her blue buddy.

programme.title: Kid-E-Cats
programme.desc: One day, Daddy takes the kittens to a balloon festival; on the way to the festival, they are reading a book about balloons and learning all about how they work; the kittens get in the balloon basket and accidentally take off.

Cisza nad rozlewiskiem
programme.desc: Nad rozlewiskiem ogólny smutek, trwają przygotowania do pogrzebu Kaśki. Małgosia jest załamana, a do tego musi zająć się wszystkimi pod nieobecność Basi. Rysio załamany po nieudanych urodzinach postanawia razem z Bronią uciec z domu.

programme.title: Cisza nad rozlewiskiem
programme.desc: Po śmierci Kasi Basia postanawia znowu opuścić rozlewisko. Wyjeżdża do Indii, by odnaleźć duchowy spokój. Krzysztof zdecydował - nie wyjedzie do Szczytna. Postanawia związać życie z Marysią i coraz lepiej czuje się w roli przyszłego ojca.

programme.title: Rozmowy (nie)wygodne
programme.desc: Inspirujące rozmowy Mariusza Szczygła z wybitnymi osobowościami świata kultury i sztuki. Prowokujące pytania, wymagające nieszablonowych odpowiedzi i odkrywania swojej osobowości. Wywiady odbywać się będą we "Wrzenie Świata" - miejscu spotkań bohemy intelektualnej Warszawy. Gość: Joanna Kurowska, aktorka.

programme.title: Wielki test
programme.desc: Czy wiemy, jak bardzo nasze życie zależy od przyrody i jej różnorodności? Bioróżnorodność to nie tylko bogactwo gatunków roślin i zwierząt, ale także nasze zdrowie, żywność, czyste powietrze i bezpieczeństwo przyszłych pokoleń. W Wielkim Teście o Bioróżnorodności sprawdzimy, ile wiemy o świecie natury i jak możemy go chronić. Bo troska o przyrodę to tak naprawdę troska o nas samych.

programme.title: Pan Mama
programme.desc: Patrycja odkrywa, że jej postać w serialu zostanie uśmiercona, a Zuza organizuje internetową kampanię ratunkową. Sylwester unika rozmowy z Mają o stracie mamy, ale w końcu musi się z tym zmierzyć. Patrycja dostaje rolę życia. Czy wyprowadzi się i zniknie z rodziny Dzików?

programme.title: Na dobre i na złe
programme.desc: Do Leśnej Góry trafia młody pacjent po próbie samobójczej, którego ocaliła koleżanka - współlokatorka. A gdy w szpitalu stan chłopaka gwałtownie się pogarsza, o jego życie walczą wspólnie Julka z doktorem Jakubkiem.

programme.title: SeriaLove Wspomnienia
programme.desc: Gośćmi Macieja Kurzajewskiego będą bohaterowie ulubionych produkcji telewizyjnych. Podążymy za historią, przeżyciami i odkryjemy nieznane sceny oraz wspomnienia z serialowych planów. Tym razem Maciej porozmawia z Marcelem Szytenchelmem, odtwórcą kultowej roli Mariana Koniuszki z serialu "Zmiennicy".

programme.title: Rozmowy (nie)wygodne
programme.desc: Inspirujące rozmowy Mariusza Szczygła z wybitnymi osobowościami świata kultury i sztuki. Prowokujące pytania, wymagające nieszablonowych odpowiedzi i odkrywania swojej osobowości. Wywiady odbywać się będą we "Wrzenie Świata" - miejscu spotkań bohemy intelektualnej Warszawy. Gość: Joanna Kurowska, aktorka.

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Celina kontynuuje działania w sprawie Justina, co spotyka się z wyraźnym niezadowoleniem ze strony Łukasza. Ostatecznie Brońska przekazuje zgromadzone dowody komisarzowi Majakowi, zwracając się do funkcjonariusza z prośbą o interwencję.

programme.title: Smaki świata po polsku
programme.desc: Ola Nguyen to mistrzyni kuchni, dzieciństwo spędziła w Wietnamie, a nad Wisłę przyjechała w wieku 7 lat. Pomaga jej Robert El Gendy, który urodził się na Mazurach, ale płynie w nim egipska krew. Któż lepiej niż ten duet zgłębi kuchnię?

programme.title: Cisza nad rozlewiskiem

programme.title: Bartoszewski. Siła przebaczenia
programme.desc: Film przedstawia życie i dziedzictwo Władysława Bartoszewskiego, historyka, dyplomaty, pisarza i świadka historii, którego życie było świadectwem mocy człowieczeństwa w obliczu tragedii. Narracja ukazuje Bartoszewskiego nie tylko jako świadka historii, ale przede wszystkim jako człowieka, który konsekwentnie odrzucał nienawiść. Film podkreśla, że przebaczenie - choć trudne - było dla niego nie akt

programme.title: Zakochaj się w Polsce
programme.desc: Tomasz Bednarek w swojej podróży po Polsce odwiedza Głuchołazy, miasto tuż obok czeskiej granicy, z niezwykłą Parkową Górą i tężnią solankową. Głuchołazy szczycą się też bogatą historią wydobycia złota. Do miasta zjeżdżają rowerzyści.

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Podczas wizyty Huberta w szpitalu Adam wysuwa pod adresem rodziny Pyrków oskarżenia o zlecenie ataku i domaga się korzyści majątkowej w zamian za milczenie. Informacja o radykalnych działaniach Daniela wywołuje u Asi głęboki wstrząs.

programme.title: Tańcząca ze światem
programme.desc: Program lifestylowo-podróżniczy, w którym prowadząca, Edyta Herbuś, pokazuje życie mieszkańców innych krajów, ich tradycje, kulturę, obyczaje oraz lokalne tańce. Edyta Herbuś odkryje przed widzami uroki i tajemnice Jordanii.

programme.title: Niezwykłe miejsca
programme.desc: Krótkie reportaże o charakterze edukacyjnym prezentujące niezwykłe miejsca w Polsce. Miejsca skrywające wiele tajemnic, owiane legendą, miejsca o bogatej historii. W tym odcinku: Osiedle Boernerowo.

programme.title: Ranczo
programme.desc: Do Wilkowyj dociera jedna z plag współczesnego świata - mafia. Konkretnie dociera dwoma czarnymi bmw, pełnymi ubranych w dresy młodzieńców o byczych karkach. Wilkowyjskie centra biznesu padają ofiarą brutalnego szantażu.

programme.title: Ekstradycja
programme.desc: W Ośrodku Integracji Europejskiej odbywa się tajne spotkanie ministra z zagranicznymi partnerami. Uczestniczy w nim Fiduk. Halski z Wojtkiem umieszczają podsłuch w sali obrad. Następnego dnia Wojtek znika w tajemniczych okolicznościach, a wraz z nim - taśma z nagraniem poufnej konferencji.

programme.title: Sterk - znaczy silny
programme.desc: Film dokumentalny o Polakach mieszkających w Norwegii. Jego celem jest przedstawienie doświadczeń i trudów emigracji na podstawie historii pięciu bohaterów.

programme.title: Rodzinka.pl
programme.desc: Podczas kolejnej kolacji u Boskich Viola i Marek grają pierwsze skrzypce. Tomek jest zazdrosny o Magdę, postanawia więc bliżej poznać ojca Dianki. Dochodzi do konfrontacji Pauli z Kacprem. Współpraca Ludwika i Agaty wchodzi na kolejny poziom.

programme.title: Ojciec Mateusz
programme.desc: W drodze na rekolekcje do sąsiedniej parafii, ojciec Mateusz zauważa taksówkę stojącą na niebezpiecznym przejeździe kolejowym. Okazuje się, że kierowca uległ tajemniczemu zatruciu. Poszkodowany następnego dnia znika ze szpitala.

programme.title: Ojciec Mateusz
programme.desc: Tragiczne wydarzenie, związane z jednym z wychowanków sandomierskiego liceum, zwraca uwagę wszystkich na trudne relacje panujące między uczniami. Zwłaszcza jedna z uczennic, Zuzanna, bardzo cierpi z powodu docinków i drwin rówieśników.

programme.title: Polacy światu
programme.desc: Karol Stefan Szolc - Rogoziński u schyłku 1881 r. wystąpił z ros. marynarki wojennej, wrócił w rodzinne strony. W Polsce zaprezentował plan ekspedycji do Kamerunu. Zdobył ok. 370 okazów. Są w Muzeum Etnograficznym w Krakowie i w Warszawie.

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Podczas wizyty Huberta w szpitalu Adam wysuwa pod adresem rodziny Pyrków oskarżenia o zlecenie ataku i domaga się korzyści majątkowej w zamian za milczenie. Informacja o radykalnych działaniach Daniela wywołuje u Asi głęboki wstrząs.

programme.title: Polacy światu
programme.desc: Bohaterem tego odcinka jest August Zamoyski - polski rzeźbiarz działający w Brazylii i Francji.

programme.title: Makłowicz w podróży
programme.desc: Makłowicz podróżuje po Tunezji, a ściślej wokół miasta Monastyr. Ciekawy jest port rybacki Teboulba, z którego Robert wypływa kutrem, by zobaczyć hodowlę ryb na pełnym morzu.

programme.title: Skarbiec sztuki Lubelszczyzny
programme.desc: Według legendy powstał w roku 1434, kiedy to gdański kupiec Henryk próbował ukraść lubelską relikwię drzewa Krzyża Świętego z kościoła oo. dominikanów.

programme.title: Korona Gór Polski
programme.desc: Tematem odcinka będzie Tarnica, najwyższy szczyt polskich Bieszczadów, zachwycający rozległymi panoramami, dziką przyrodą i niepowtarzalnym klimatem bieszczadzkich połonin.

programme.title: Pięknie przyprawiONA
programme.desc: Mrożenie jest najzdrowszym sposobem przechowywania żywności. Zamrożone produkty nie tracą właściwości odżywczych i nie zawierają konserwantów, a kończący się okres letni i rozkwitający czas jesieni to najlepszy okres na przygotowanie aromatycznych i pełnych witamin zapasów w naszej zamrażarce. W programie dowiemy się, jak gotować z wykorzystaniem mrożonek, tak by wydobyć z nich aromat pełnych słoń

programme.title: Profesor Michałowski. Droga do Faras
programme.desc: Historia najwybitniejszego polskiego archeologa, prof. Kazimierza Michałowskiego i jego największego odkrycia w Faras. Bez jego determinacji i pasji nie byłoby polskiej archeologii z jej międzynarodowymi sukcesami i pozycją, jaką ma dziś.

programme.title: Na dobre i na złe
programme.desc: Doktor Jakubek na dyżurze nagle zaczyna tak źle się czuć, że przerywa pracę przekonany, że ma zawał. Oliwa zostaje sama na placu boju i musi przez to samodzielnie wykonać ryzykowną operację u kobiety z poważnym urazem wątroby.

programme.title: Na sygnale
programme.desc: Wiktor próbuje na nowo porozumieć się z Czarkiem, a w pracy zespół doktora Banacha trafia na starszego, zdezorientowanego mężczyznę, który błąka się w nocy po ulicy i u którego lekarz diagnozuje krwotok wewnętrzny.

programme.title: Na sygnale
programme.desc: Basia i Dobromir planują swoje "rozstanie" - na przyjęciu z okazji rocznicy Lisickich. W pracy muszą pomóc dziewczynie, która o mało nie utonęła w basenie. Z kolei Britney z Alkiem próbują uratować chłopca, który stracił nagle przytomność.

programme.title: Zmiennicy
programme.desc: Przed sądem stają oskarżeni o porwanie taksówki strażak Kuśmider i Krashan. Sprawa narkotyków jest niejasna, oskarżeni łżą jak z nut, a świadkowie plączą się w zeznaniach. W efekcie Kuśmider i Krashan otrzymują wyrok w zawieszeniu.

programme.title: Close Your Eyes Before It's Dark:13
programme.desc: 一封突如其來的簡訊，將闊別多年的八位好友齊聚山中民宿，預備一同挖出學生時代埋下的時空膠囊，沒想卻讓一樁昔日醜聞意外出土，使心結與宿怨逐漸淹沒了理智。第一具屍體的出現，象徵純潔的友誼就此告終；第二具屍體的出現，宣告殺人遊戲正式啟動。風雨阻斷逃生去路，死亡數目逐漸升高。在人人自危的時刻，不願扣下扳機的那個人，也許就是下一具屍體......。

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Gabriela piensa en el cumpleaños de Jimena, cree que es un día amargo para su hija, pero Norma y ella se divierten con Juan y Óscar. Franco se enreda al aceptar ser el secretario de Eduvina.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Jimena le cuenta a Norma sus sospechas sobre las intenciones de Óscar y Juan, luego que los escucha hablar de la fortuna Elizondo y encuentra fotos de Libia, se aterran al recordar quién era.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Hortencia, una de las vendedoras del mercado, le cuenta todo a Jimena acerca de la muerte de Libia. Franco renuncia a su empleo con Eduvina, y ella le arma un escándalo a Rosario en el bar.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Jimena cree que Juan y Óscar quieren envenenarla a ella y a su hermana, tras golpear a su esposo, Norma la rescata en la calle. Franco es traicionado por Rosario y Eduvina intenta suicidarse.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Franco llama a una ambulancia para salvar a Óscar, Juan confirma que las Elizondo saben todo sobre Libia. Eva confiesa lo que hizo y su rencor hacia Gabriela y revela el secreto de su hija.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Norma y Jimena llegan a la hacienda y se enteran de la traición de Eva, Fernando y Sara quieren denunciarla a ella y a los Reyes, mientras Gabriela retiene a sus hijas para protegerlas.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Se arma una fuerte pelea cuando los Reyes llegan a la hacienda para hablar con Norma y Jimena. Eva se va de la hacienda por orden de Fernando y Raquel le prohíbe que se acerque a su hija Ruth.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Armando ordena un ataque contra los hermanos Reyes, Franco encuentra una oportunidad para revertir la desgracia de su familia después de perder a Rosario. Norma se empeña en olvidar a Juan.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Franco firma los documentos que lo acreditan como el propietario de la fortuna de Eduvina Trueba, aunque Juan persuade a su hermano para evitar que arruine su vida con una mujer mayor que él.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Eduvina no sigue las órdenes de su médico, Franco tampoco calma su euforia y las consecuencias son inevitables. Juan y Óscar quieren irse del pueblo, imaginan a su hermano en una luna de miel.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Malcolm y Carmela humillan a Franco y acusan a Eva de ladrona, ella se entera de que Reyes es dueño de la hacienda y busca a sus hermanos. Juan obliga al viudo de Eduvina a poner todo en su sitio.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Franco le pide ayuda a Juan y a Óscar, su hermano mayor se niega hasta que Eva lo convence para que acepte. Jimena consigue trabajo, Fernando llega con Pepita a la hacienda Elizondo.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Los Reyes asumen sus responsabilidades en la hacienda, pasan los meses y Norma da a luz a su bebé, Jimena tiene éxito en su trabajo aunque extraña a Óscar, él no aguanta los celos al verla.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Juan acepta la decisión de su hermano porque es la oportunidad para acercarse a Norma, ella se preocupa cuando ve a Fernando con su bebé. Jimena le muestra a Ruth unas fotos de Libia.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Sarita se encuentra con el nuevo dueño de la hacienda Trueba, con quien tiene una fuerte discusión, ella cae del caballo y se desmaya, cuando despierta está en la habitación de Franco.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Sarita y Franco pelean de nuevo, esta vez delante de todos los invitados a la fiesta en honor a los Reyes. Juan muere de celos al ver a Fernando con Gabriela, teme que Norma haya vuelto con él.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Juan conoce a su hijo y lo toma en sus brazos con ternura, Gabriela arma un escándalo hasta que Norma aclara que él tiene derechos porque es el padre, luego ella desacata la orden de su madre.

programme.title: Deltas of the World
programme.sub-title: Irrawaddy Delta: The Magical World of Mangroves
programme.desc: The Irrawaddy Delta in southern Myanmar is home to the most diverse mangrove forests in the world. The forests serve as natural protection against cyclones that regularly strike the region. The Irrawaddy's widely branching tributaries not only provide schools of fish and rich nutrients, but also function as the most important transport route for the people living in the delta. The greengrocer couple U Tin Hlaing and Daw Khin Lay supply the villages downstream with their fresh produce. But they do not go any further than the Meinmahla Kyun Wildlife Sanctuary. From that point on, the river becomes increasingly turbulent, too dangerous for their small, flat boat. The sanctuary is home to a variety of animal species including the rare Irrawaddy dolphins, saltwater crocodiles, birds of prey such as black kites and brahminy kites, migratory birds such as spoon-billed sandpipers, woodcocks, great cormorants and various anatids. Ranger Lha Soe Win and his colleagues regularly patrol the nature reserve to monitor the animal population and make sure the mangroves are no longer illegally logged for firewood. Since the 1970s, the mangrove population has declined by more than 60 percent, with dramatic consequences for the inhabitants of the delta. Cyclone Nargis, the most devastating cyclone to date, claimed the lives of around 130,000 Burmese in 2008. Together with scientists from the conservation charity Flora and Fauna International, the rangers are working on reforesting the mangroves to restore their function as a natural barrier in the future.

programme.title: Deltas of the World
programme.desc: Hardly any other area is as unspoiled as the Yukon Delta in western Alaska. This fascinating network of swamps and river arms looks like a landscape at the beginning of mankind. Only 25,000 people live in this barren region, which is almost as big as Greece. Most of these inhabitants are indigenous and belong to the ethnic group of the Yupik. They make their living on the steep banks of the Yukon River. And in their villages, built on piles to protect them against flooding, you can see the effects of climate changes on nature - and on the community life of the indigenous population. On the trail of the national fish of Alaska, the salmon, the film follows the Yukon River and follows moose hunters, migratory birds and scientists who do research in the delta.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry, Cherry and the girls form a new band, Strawberry and the Sweet Beats, and prepare to go on the road to perform at the Opening Ceremony of the Berry Big City Games! While master mechanic Berrykin Bruce turns Cherry's tour bus into the band's hotel-on-wheels, Strawberry and her friends pack for the big trip. But the rest of Berry Bitty City points out that someone needs to run the girls' businesses while they are gone.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Berrykins Ed and Earl report to Princess Berrykin and Strawberry that they are certain there is a monster in the berry patch! They saw something with many noses and many tails making weird noises in the bushes. But upon further investigation by Strawberry and her friends, it is discovered that friendly boy Huckleberry Pie was driving his pet-mobile of orphan dogs through the countryside, took a wrong turn and got stuck near Berry Bitty City.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Blueberry is disappointed in the girls' lack of enthusiasm for the Patti Persimmon mystery novels, her favorite book series. She finds herself missing the company of her fellow Persimmon fan Huckleberry, and thinks up a great way to get him to visit. She invites Huck to co-write a story with her to submit to an online mystery magazine.. Huck eagerly accepts and comes for a visit.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: The Mystery of the Disappearing Dog Show
programme.desc: When Huckleberry and Blueberry's Patti Persimmon-style mystery story is rejected by an online mystery magazine, Blueberry and Huck have to come up with a new way to raise support for Huckleberry's Hotel for Homeless Pets back in Berry Big City. Strawberry suggests they hold a big dog show! Plum makes over-ambitious plans to display talents that her dog does not quite have, trying to teach him complicated dance routines.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The Baby Berrykins are enthralled by a fairytale that Blueberry reads to them for Story Time. Charmed by their reaction, Strawberry suggests that the girls do a "berrytale play" for the kids, sort of a "Story Time On Stage." Plum volunteers to direct it. She envisions a small, simple production-until she hears about a gigantic production of "Snowberry and the Seven Berrykins" that's a smash hit in Berry Big City.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry and the girls excitedly plan to put on a "Story Time On Stage" musical play for the Berrykin kids: "Berryella and Prince Berry Charming," directed and choreographed by Plum, with musical direction by Cherry. Strawberry will play Berryella, with Lemon and Blueberry as her comically jealous stepsisters, and costume designer Raspberry as her Fairy Fashionmother.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Blueberry and Huck turn the Baby Berrykins' favorite fairy tale, "The Littlest Berrykin," into a comedy play. They pitch it to director Plum and the assembled cast and crew using a large storybook. As Huck and Blueberry narrate the story, we push in on the book and its illustrations transition into animation. In the story, the King and Queen of the Berry Patch (played by Huck and Blueberry) are retiring to the tropics.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Orange wants to spend the day teaching her puppy to fetch, but the frisky little gal doesn't seem to understand the "retrieve" part of the activity-as soon as she gets the ball, she runs out of sight and returns moments later without it. Orange gets a new ball and tries again, with the same results. Over and over, until Orange is out of balls. Puzzled and frustrated that she can't find where her pup has stashed them, she goes to enlist her friends to help her search.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Cherry Jam is being driven to distraction! She can't finish a song that she promised to write for a singing group, thanks to the earsplitting noise from Berrykin construction crews who are trying to find the sparkleberry juice blockage that has shut down the town's power. Strawberry can't cook in the café, Lemon's hair salon appliances are running out of control-life in Berry Bitty City is impossible!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With the power completely out in Berry Bitty City, the girls go on a camping trip to be out of the way of the Berrykin work crews. Lemon is nervous because she believes there is a creepy creature in the forest (that she read about in a book Blueberry loaned her), and the girls get the nervous bug, but Strawberry turns their apprehension into fun by daring her friends to stay out in the woods the longest!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls are driven to distraction by their frisky puppies frolicking all over Berry Bitty City! Full of energy and thinking that everything in town is a toy for them to play with, they cause comical mayhem wherever they go. Strawberry suggests the pups need a place of their own where they can play, a dog park! The girls decide to call in Huckleberry, who runs an animal hotel in Berry Big City, to help design the park.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls plan a formal afternoon lawn party tea to inaugurate their new dog park. Plum is in charge of decorations, Cherry music, and Strawberry snacks. There's even a giant, dog-shaped ice sculpture. As the girls get dressed, Raspberry puts the finishing touches on the high-fashion hats that will accompany their beautiful gowns. At last everything is ready. But when the gate opens... the puppies back away!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: To convince the dance-averse Huckleberry to attend the big masquerade ball at the dog park, Blueberry promises she'll stay by his side the whole evening and make sure he doesn't have to dance. But as the day of the ball dawns, Blueberry awakens with a bad cold. She doesn't know how to tell Huck that she can't go to the ball. Lemon and Raspberry misinterpret her sniffles, thinking she's so heartbroken to be disappointing Huck that she's crying!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: The Berry Biggest, Berry Baddest Bakeoff
programme.desc: Berry Bitty City is abuzz as Berrykin Bloom introduces the biggest, juiciest, strangest fruit anyone has ever seen! It's the size of a house, shaped like a strawberry, colored like a watermelon and has a spiky pineapple top. "I call it the sparklestrawwaterpineberry!" says Berrykin Bloom. Princess Berrykin declares it the greatest achievement in Berryculture she's ever witnessed.

The filmed concert was aired on PBS as an episode of Great Performances, and the show was subsequently released on DVD along with the audio CD to create the album package, although the audio disc only featured eight of the songs from the concert. programme.title: Andrea Bacchetti
programme.desc: At the age of eleven, Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti (*1977) debuted with Italian chamber orchestra I Solisti Veneti under the baton of Claudio Scimone. He performed on international festivals and in prestigious concert halls worldwide. Besides, he appeared with several renowned orchestras such as Lucerne Festival Strings, Camerata Salzburg, and Prague Chamber Orchestra. In the current recital, Bacchetti performs J. S. Bach's celebrated Goldberg Variations, BWV 988. Completed in 1741, the work is named after German harpsichordist Johann Gottlieb Goldberg, who might have been the first to have performed the work. Bach's masterpiece consists of an aria and a set of thirty variations. Rather than writing variations on the aria's melody, Bach used the accompanying bass line as his starting point. This performance was recorded at Theater Carlo Felice in Genoa, Italy, on April 13, 2015.

programme.title: Tim Weiss, Arctic Philharmonic, Berit Norbakken Solset & Øystein Moen
programme.sub-title: Glass - A Descent into the Maelström
programme.desc: ‘A Descent into the Maelström' (1841) is American writer Edgar Allan Poe's short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, inside the Arctic Circle of northern Norway. After a treacherous whirlpool drags their boat down, only one of them survives. American composer Philipp Glass based his choral work for the Australian Dance Theatre on this story. The piece was performed at the Adelaide Festival of Arts in 1986. Beacon Isle Films recorded an arrangement of Glass's work for symphony orchestra, performed by the Arctic Philharmonic Orchestra and Choir conducted by Tim Weiss. Soprano Berit Norbakken Solset is the soloist. The Artic Philharmonic Orchestra is the world's youngest and northernmost professional orchestral institution, presenting circa 150 performances and concerts each year. This 2019 recording was made against the backdrop of Lofoten's spectacular landscape: the very surroundings that inspired Poe's story.

programme.title: Sinne Eeg, Kristoffer Appel & Isabel Schwartzbach
programme.desc: The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies — to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune, and many more. Join the orchestra on the third and final symphonic journey through musical universes and cinematic galaxies — all the way to the outermost asteroids and back to Earth again.

programme.title: Ballet Jörgen de Canada
programme.desc: By popular demand, Canada's Ballet Jörgen reprises the tragic tale of the Russian Grand Duchess Anastasia, 10 years after the ballet's premiere and 100 years after Anastasia's story. Created by acclaimed choreographer Bengt Jörgen, the ballet is set to an original score for orchestra by Russian composer Ivan Barbotin. He previously wrote the scores for two of Canada's Ballet Jörgen's most popular ballets: The Velveteen Rabbit and The Emperor's New Clothes. Anastasia is both the tragic story of an innocent young girl and a modern myth: the exact events of that fateful summer of 1918 are shrouded in the mists of time. The ballet explores this lovable yet controversial main character's emotions, aspirations, and affections, as she is faced with a world in turmoil that undergoes an inevitable transformation. Anastasia is a sumptuous ballet performance, where costume and set design as well as the exquisite stage lighting reveal Canada's Ballet Jörgen's dedication to creative quality.

Nicolas Hulot propose d'en découvrir les richesses, en partant de la pointe Est de l'Indonésie, en Papouasie-Occidentale, pour se retrouver en fin de voyage dans la baie de Donsol, aux Philippines.

programme.title: Des trains pas comme les autres
programme.desc: Au Portugal, Philippe Gougler débute son voyage à Porto, au pied du célèbre pont Dom-Luis, construit par un disciple de Gustave Eiffel. Il embarque ensuite à bord d'un train mythique, qui jusqu'en 1970, était le train officiel des chefs d'Etat et des papes en visite dans le pays. programme.title: Des trains pas comme les autres
programme.desc: Pour ce nouvel épisode des Trains pas comme les autres, direction l'Asie, et plus précisément l'Indonésie, le pays des îles. Le voyage de Philippe débute à Padang, sur l'île de Sumatra. Il prend le train pour rejoindre la région du Minangkabau et ses fabuleuses rizières. programme.title: Cuba, voyage dans une nation low-tech
programme.desc: Coupé de la mondialisation, Cuba a dû repenser ses modes de production pour contourner l'embargo international. Tour d'horizon de certaines de ces innovations frugales.

programme.title: Ushuaïa Nature
programme.desc: Nicolas Hulot et son équipe se sont rendus en Afrique du Sud et au Botswana, filmer plusieurs espèces menacées. Posant leurs caméras en Afrique australe, ils se sont intéressés aux flamants roses. Puis Nicolas Hulot est parti à la rencontre des requins et des sardines, avant de prendre le pouls de la migration des zèbres. Il a achevé son périple à Cape Town, territoire du grand requin blanc.

programme.title: Des trains pas comme les autres
programme.desc: En Afrique, Philippe Gougler découvre des trains de voyageurs qui traversent la savane. Dans une réserve, au milieu des lions, girafes, et zèbres, il rencontre un médecin aux méthodes traditionnelles qui utilise de la semence de babouin pour concocter ses remèdes. Le voyage continue à la frontière entre les deux pays, séparés par les célèbres chutes Victoria qui font partie des plus belles du mond

programme.title: Des trains pas comme les autres
programme.desc: On pense connaître le Maroc, pays proche par sa langue, son histoire et sa proximité géographique. Pourtant, à travers ce périple ferroviaire, Philippe Gougler découvre un pays surprenant, aux richesses infinies. programme.title: Des trains pas comme les autres
programme.desc: Au Brésil, la musique et la fête ne sont jamais très loin. La joyeuse foule qui remplit le train en partance pour la campagne est là pour le rappeler. programme.title: Des trains pas comme les autres
programme.desc: Paysages pittoresques, villages de montagne, artisanat intéressant, traditions culturelles de différents peuples et, bien sûr, tout cela au rythme des roues avec le présentateur familier Philippe Gougler. Cette fois-ci, nous découvrons la Suisse en été.

programme.title: Des trains pas comme les autres

programme.title: Ushuaïa Nature

Son périple s'achève par une rencontre avec les Indiens Zo'és.

programme.desc: Gérald Ariano part sur les terres aveyronnaises pour rencontrer Mathilde et Romain dans un monde dans lequel le cheval et l'homme se rencontrent dans le respect.

programme.title: Plastique, le suicide collectif ?
programme.desc: Les scientifiques alertent sur les dangers du plastique pour notre santé. Des milliers de produits chimiques non testés contaminent notre alimentation et provoquent des cancers.

programme.title: Opération Okavango
programme.desc: Découverte de la Namibie jusqu'aux rives de l'Okavango, au Botswana. La côte des Squelettes abrite des colonies d'otaries et le désert de Namib est peuplé d'animaux tels le cafard à dos blanc, la vipère des sables et la "dame blanche", une araignée surprenante.

programme.title: Des trains pas comme les autres

programme.title: Des trains pas comme les autres

programme.title: La science des forces de la nature
La foudre, un éclair de génie

programme.desc: Face aux défis du changement climatique, des inégalités et de la pollution, 36 Australiens ordinaires transforment leur pays à travers des initiatives locales. De la protection environnementale à la lutte contre les discriminations, leurs actions dans les communautés créent un impact significatif. Des projets environnementaux aux programmes sociaux, ils démontrent la force de l'engagement citoyen.

Най-смъртоносните природни явления в света S2 E6 Студент описва урагана Мария от 2017 г., който опустошава Пуерто Рико. Градушка унищожава дом на семейство в Далас. Турист в дивата природа се опитва да спаси живота си при внезапно наводнение.
Гладиатори S1 E4 В далечния север на Америка има области с реки, блата и крайбрежия. Животните тук са най-добрите бойци, тъй като те са елитът на природата и калени в битки воини.

Ягуарски хроники S1 E4 Сред бури, наводнения и прекъсвания на електрозахранването Лизи и ветеринарният лекар Жоарес се мъчат да поставят нашийници на повече ягуари. Срещаме нова женска, която екипът е нетърпелив да проучи.

Дълбините на Австралия S1 E3 Посещаваме дивите земи, където пустинята на Австралия се среща с горещия и враждебен Индийски океан, докато биоложката Лизи Дейли се гмурка с тигрови акули, манти и номадски костенурки.

Скритият вулкан: Изригване от ада На 15 януари 2022 г. вулканът Хунга Тонга - Хунга Хаапай изригна с мощност, равностойна на над 60 милиона тона тротил. Каква е причината за такова изключително мощно изригване на този вулкан?

Дивата Белгия S1 E3 Белгийските гори крият същества с необичайно поведение; мраволъвите яростно дърпат плячката си в пясъчни фунии да нахранят ларвите си, а росянките ловят непредпазливи насекоми с лепкавите си пипала.
Най-смъртоносните природни явления в света S2 E5 Капската провинция в Южна Африка е поразена от силна буря и катастрофални горски пожари, които претоварват службите за спешна помощ.

Дивата Виена Виена е един от най-биологично активните градове в света; дивата природа процъфтява в нейните дворци, църкви и градини, а Донауинзел служи както за контрол на наводненията, така и за зона за отдих.

Екстремното речно предизвикателство на Стив Бакшал S1 E1 Стив Бакшал изследва река Балием на остров Нова Гвинея; той започва пътешествието си от езерото Хабема и се натъква на едни от най-екстремните бързеи, съществуващи на планетата.

Сан Андреас: надпревара с времето Разломът Сан Андреас е пресечна точка на две тектонични плочи, простиращи се през Сан Франциско и Лос Анджелис. Той е дълъг 1300 км и в момента е най-проучваният феномен в света.
Гладиатори S1 E1 Сухият сезон затяга хватката си върху малък водоем в голямата савана на Южна Африка; тук група гладиатори - големи и малки - са събрани в опасна близост.

Гладиатори S1 E2 Австралия е земя, отделена от другите от времето на динозаврите; изолирана в продължение на милиони години, еволюцията е превърнала нейните животни в най-впечатляващите гладиатори на планетата.

Атака на акули самураи През 1920-те години близо до вътрешното море Сето в Япония е открит 3000-годишен скелет с необичайно дълбоки порезни следи. Учени имат изумителна теория за случая: дали този мъж е бил убит от акула?

Дълбините на Австралия S1 E1 Изследвайте бреговете на Северната територия и водите на Големия бариерен риф, където биоложката Лизи Дейли проучва защо толкова много странни и смъртоносни същества живеят в този отдалечен район.

Дълбините на Австралия S1 E2 Потопете се в хладните води край южния бряг, изправете се лице в лице с величествени сиви акули дойки, променящи формата си сепии и огромни сини китове и научете защо тези морета са пълни с живот.

Дълбините на Австралия S1 E3 Посещаваме дивите земи, където пустинята на Австралия се среща с горещия и враждебен Индийски океан, докато биоложката Лизи Дейли се гмурка с тигрови акули, манти и номадски костенурки.

Екстремното речно предизвикателство на Стив Бакшал S1 E1 Стив Бакшал изследва река Балием на остров Нова Гвинея; той започва пътешествието си от езерото Хабема и се натъква на едни от най-екстремните бързеи, съществуващи на планетата.

Екстремното речно предизвикателство на Стив Бакшал S1 E2 Стив и екипът му продължават пътуването си с каяк из долното дефиле на Балием; с извисяващите се над главите им назъбени скални стени и разбиващите се течения, рискът от преобръщане е постоянен.

Арктически ветеринари S1 E1 Д-р Крис е в Чърчил, Манитоба за драматичното освобождаване на възрастна полярна мечка; 800-килограмов мускусен бик, спешно нуждаещ се от подрязване на копитата, се събужда по средата на процедурата.
Тексаски спасители на алигатори S1 E8 Двама ветерани от американската армия помагат на Гари със спасителна операция в парка, а Арли и Блу измъкват борбен алигатор от опасна ситуация.

Дивата Белгия S1 E1 Белгийските потоци и реки са дом на безброй бобри, хитри жълтоухи водни змии и риби бодливки, мъжките от които изграждат сложни гнезда и се оказват невероятно отдадени и грижовни бащи.
Дивата Белгия S1 E2 Мигриращите птици започват годишното си пътуване на юг и обичат да спират из провинциална Белгия; събирането на жеравите и грандиозното им отлитане е спиращ дъха спектакъл.

Дивата Белгия S1 E3 Белгийските гори крият същества с необичайно поведение; мраволъвите яростно дърпат плячката си в пясъчни фунии да нахранят ларвите си, а росянките ловят непредпазливи насекоми с лепкавите си пипала.

Дивата Виена Виена е един от най-биологично активните градове в света; дивата природа процъфтява в нейните дворци, църкви и градини, а Донауинзел служи както за контрол на наводненията, така и за зона за отдих.

programme.desc: 「宵夜係自願，收夜係被迫」 疫情後，相信全港打工仔都面對同一問題，一但OT收夜，在市面還有甚麼餐廳可以光顧？ 「宵夜」係你食飽之後的飯後甜品，「收夜」係捱完OT之後但咩都未食的人間悲劇。 為回應市民訴求，Jacky, Arvin 化身「收夜的美食家」，走訪香港各區晚上9點後依然熱鬧營業的各式餐廳，讓各位觀眾知道即使要OT或收夜，除左連鎖店的漢堡薯條，仲可以選擇中式、日式、美式、韓式，港式飲茶鑊氣小炒通通都有！ Jacky Fan及Arvin曾傲棐除了會介紹這些「收夜」餐廳的美食之外，也會訪問這些小店老闆了解他們的故事之餘，亦有嘉賓好友作為飯腳！ 除「收夜」餐廳美食介紹之外，也會有小環節介紹主持們的神秘食法，讓大家可以快速方便吃到一個有溫度兼好味道的Late Dinner！

"The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

Woran liegt es, dass dem einen eine Stunde ewig lang vorkommt, der andere aber das Gefühl hat, es sei nur ein Augenblick vergangen? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Priscilla
programme.desc: When teenage Priscilla Beaulieu meets Elvis Presley at a party, the man who is already a meteoric rock 'n' roll superstar becomes someone entirely unexpected in private moments: a thrilling crush, an ally in loneliness, a vulnerable best friend.

programme.title: So Undercover
programme.desc: The FBI hires a young private detective to go undercover at a sorority to guard the daughter of an important witness in an organized-crime case.

programme.title: Fatal Beauty
programme.desc: Detective Rita Rizzoli (Whoopi Goldberg) is accustomed to donning costumes and going undercover to nail crooks. But she'll be required to use all of her get-ups and more when a major cocaine ring is suspected of turning out a potent new strain of the drug, called "Fatal Beauty." With the help of her partner, Jimenez (Ruben Blades), and a former bodyguard for a local cartel (Sam Elliott), Rita will do whatever it takes to find out who's dealing Fatal Beauty and stop them.

programme.title: Paradise Hills
programme.desc: Young women must band together to escape from a seemingly idyllic island that holds a sinister secret.

programme.title: STOP
programme.desc: Aktualiteti shqiptar ”alla Stop”, problematika e njerëzve të thjeshtë, që pasi kanë trokitur në të gjitha dyert, gjejnë zgjidhje vetëm në ”Stop” , video-kamera të fshehta, që denoncojnë e demaskojnë korrupsionin, dhunën apo abuzimin seksual. Akte humanizmi për më të pamundurit e fatkeqët, të cilëve u ndryshon jeta. Nje emision i gjithi vetëm për njerëzit e zakonshëm dhe me njerëzit në qendër.

programme.title: Aldo Morning Show
programme.desc: Dielli lind ndryshe në TVKLAN, në 7 pa 1 minutë! Të lodhur apo të palodhur nga gjumi i natës, nga e djeshmja me halle e strese, Aldo ju fton të zgjohemi me buzeqeshje, me qeshje, me nënqeshje, dhe më kryesorja. me një adrenaline të paparë për ta nisu.

programme.title: Shije Shtepie
programme.desc: Emision edukues - informues - argetues me zn.Tefta dhe Katerina Trungu. Cdo ditë me recetat e thjeshta dhe mbi te gjitha ekonomike te Zj.Vjollca duke edukuar amvisat si te ushqehemi shëndetshëm. Rubrika te ndryshme me te ftuar speciale me këshilla te thjeshta praktike, të kuptueshme nga te gjithë, për cdo aspekt të të përditshmes.

programme.title: Shtëpiake të dëshpëruara
programme.desc: Komedia me skenarin me te mire te pershtatur nga versioni amerikan. Jeta dhe dashurite e pese heroinave te serialit qe jetojne ne rrugicen ”Trendafil”: Jasemin, Nermin, Zelish, Elif dhe Emel.

programme.title: Lajme
programme.desc: Lajme nga vendi dhe bota.

programme.title: Lule të vetmuara
programme.desc: Nje drame familjare dhe njerezore e disa vajzave jetime, te cilat do te mesojne si te perballojne jeten krejtesisht te vetmuara, te dashurojne, te bejne gabime, te rrezohen, te poshterohen, te ringrihen dhe te mbijetojne duke u mbeshtetur tek njera-tjetra! Nje histori mbijetese e disa vajzave te reja, ne nje bote te madhe, ku ato jane thjesht ”Lule” te vetmuara!

programme.title: Të braktisurit
programme.desc: Kur jeta të merr gjithçka, mbetet vetëm forca për të luftuar. Një histori e jashtezakonshme për familjen, sakrificën dhe shpresën. Mes vështirësive dhe padrejtësive, ata kanë vetëm njëri-tjetrin. Një serial i mbushur me emocione të forta dhe momente të paharrueshme. Rrugëtimi emocionues i gjashtë fëmijëve jetimë që luftojnë për të mbetur bashkë në një botë që përpiqet t’i ndajë. Seriali qe ka prekur zemrat e miliona shikuesve dhe me i klikuari ne mediat sociale me disa aktore yje.

programme.title: Tradhtia
programme.desc: Ajo besoi tek dashuria dhe tek familja. Besoi se pas 30 vitesh martesë, e njihte njeriun që kishte në krah. Gyzide ka ndërtuar jetën e saj mbi drejtësinë. Por tani, drejtësinë do ta kërkojë brenda familjes së saj. Kur e vërteta del në dritë, asgjë nuk do të jetë më si më parë. A mund ta rindërtosh jetën pasi zbulon se gjithçka që besoje ishte një gënjeshtër? Vahide Perçin në një nga rolet më të fuqishme të karrierës së saj.

programme.title: Lajme
programme.desc: Lajme nga vendi dhe bota.

programme.title: Mëkate dhe trëndafila
programme.desc: Një sekret i fshehur për vite me radhë. Një familje në prag të shkatërrimit. Dhe një dashuri që lind mes dhimbjes dhe së vërtetës. Çdo trëndafil fsheh një sekret dhe çdo mëkat ka një çmim. Ai besonte te familja. Ajo besonte te e vërteta. Por kur sekretet dalin në dritë, asgjë nuk mbetet si më parë. Dashuri, tradhti dhe emocione që sfidojnë fatin. Me aktoret e famshem: Cemre Baysel dhe Murat Yildirim.

programme.title: Rudina
programme.desc: Një show argëtues dhe informativ nga Rudina Magjistari, që e shoqeron çdo pasdite familjet shqiptare me të ftuar të shumtë e VIP, por dhe njerez të e thjeshte me historitë e tyre personale.

programme.title: Mashtruesit
programme.desc: Një dramë e mbushur me intriga, sekrete, dhe lojëra të rrezikshme, ku e vërteta dhe gënjeshtra ndërthuren në çdo hap. Ertan, një avokat i talentuar i cili së bashku me të atin, nuk heziton të përdorë metoda të pazakonta për të fituar çështjet e tyre dhe Asja, një grua që përballet me vështirësi të mëdha dhe detyrohet të përdorë zgjuarsinë dhe mashtrimin për të mbajtur familjen e saj. Sa më shumë zbulohen sekretet, aq më shumë bëhet e vështirë të dallosh se kush është viktimë, kush është mashtrue.

programme.title: Lajme
programme.desc: Lajme nga vendi dhe bota.

programme.desc: Aktualiteti shqiptar ”alla Stop”, problematika e njerëzve të thjeshtë, që pasi kanë trokitur në të gjitha dyert, gjejnë zgjidhje vetëm në ”Stop” , video-kamera të fshehta, që denoncojnë e demaskojnë korrupsionin, dhunën apo abuzimin seksual. programme.title: Opinion
programme.desc: Emisioni politik më i ndjekur dhe më i preferuar në ekranet shqiptare nga Blendi Fevziu. Arena e politikës shqiptare që prej 31 gushtit 1997. Komente, analiza, debate, personazhe, dëshmi dhe fakte konkrete. Ngjarjet më të fundit dhe më të rëndësishme...

programme.title: Lajme
programme.desc: Lajme nga vendi dhe bota.

programme.title: Karteli
programme.desc: Vellezerit qe krijuan perandorine me te madhe te krimit te organizuar ne Cali gjate viteve ’60 - ’70. Familja, romancat dhe ambicja e dy vellezerve per te mbreteruar industrine e droges ne Kolumbi. Vellezerit Villegas, te njohur ndryshe si ”Los Caballeros de Cali”, kriminelet me te kerkuar ne te gjithe boten... Historia e vertete se si ata u bene nga femije te varfer, ne boset e droges. Bazuar ne librin ”El cartel de los sapos” te Andres Lopez.

Akte humanizmi për më të pamundurit e fatkeqët, të cilëve u ndryshon jeta. Nje emision i gjithi vetëm për njerëzit e zakonshëm dhe me njerëzit në qendër.

programme.title: S7E0 - X-FACTOR Albania
programme.desc: Talent-show me emocionues i globit me Alketa Vejsiu & Vera Grabocka, edicioni i 7-te. Spektakli qe i shnderron talentet ne yjet e muzikes. Audicione dritheruese, emocionet unike te skenes, performanca spektalolare, juri brilante me superstaret e muzikes shqiptare por jo vetem... Nje format emocionues qe ”prodhon” yjet e ardhshem te skenes muzikore shqiptare.

programme.title: Karteli
programme.desc: Dy vellezer qe krijuan perandorine me te madhe te krimit te organizuar. Karteli rikthehet qe nga origjina e tyre. Ne Cali gjate viteve ’60 - ’70, familja, romancat dhe ambicja e dy vellezerve per te mbreteruar industrine e droges ne Kolumbi. Vellezerit Villegas, te njohur ndryshe si ”Los Caballeros de Cali”, kriminelet me te kerkuar ne te gjithe boten... Seriali me i klikuar ne Netflix se fundmi, prodhim i vitit 2021 qe rrefen historine e vertete se si ata u bene nga femije te varfer ne boset.

programme.title: Mashtruesit
programme.desc: Një dramë e mbushur me intriga, sekrete, dhe lojëra të rrezikshme, ku e vërteta dhe gënjeshtra ndërthuren në çdo hap. Ertan, një avokat i talentuar i cili së bashku me të atin, nuk heziton të përdorë metoda të pazakonta për të fituar çështjet e tyre dhe Asja, një grua që përballet me vështirësi të mëdha dhe detyrohet të përdorë zgjuarsinë dhe mashtrimin për të mbajtur familjen e saj. Sa më shumë zbulohen sekretet, aq më shumë bëhet e vështirë të dallosh se kush është viktimë, kush është mashtrue.

programme.title: Mëkate dhe trëndafila
programme.desc: Një sekret i fshehur për vite me radhë. Një familje në prag të shkatërrimit. Dhe një dashuri që lind mes dhimbjes dhe së vërtetës. Çdo trëndafil fsheh një sekret dhe çdo mëkat ka një çmim. Ai besonte te familja. Ajo besonte te e vërteta. Por kur sekretet dalin në dritë, asgjë nuk mbetet si më parë. Dashuri, tradhti dhe emocione që sfidojnë fatin. Me aktoret e famshem: Cemre Baysel dhe Murat Yildirim.

programme.title: Të braktisurit
programme.desc: Kur jeta të merr gjithçka, mbetet vetëm forca për të luftuar. Një histori e jashtezakonshme për familjen, sakrificën dhe shpresën. Mes vështirësive dhe padrejtësive, ata kanë vetëm njëri-tjetrin. Një serial i mbushur me emocione të forta dhe momente të paharrueshme. Rrugëtimi emocionues i gjashtë fëmijëve jetimë që luftojnë për të mbetur bashkë në një botë që përpiqet t’i ndajë. Seriali qe ka prekur zemrat e miliona shikuesve dhe me i klikuari ne mediat sociale me disa aktore yje.

programme.title: Tradhtia
programme.desc: Ajo besoi tek dashuria dhe tek familja. Besoi se pas 30 vitesh martesë, e njihte njeriun që kishte në krah. Gyzide ka ndërtuar jetën e saj mbi drejtësinë. Por tani, drejtësinë do ta kërkojë brenda familjes së saj. Kur e vërteta del në dritë, asgjë nuk do të jetë më si më parë. A mund ta rindërtosh jetën pasi zbulon se gjithçka që besoje ishte një gënjeshtër? Vahide Perçin në një nga rolet më të fuqishme të karrierës së saj.

programme.title: Lule të vetmuara
programme.desc: Nje drame familjare dhe njerezore e disa vajzave jetime, te cilat do te mesojne si te perballojne jeten krejtesisht te vetmuara, te dashurojne, te bejne gabime, te rrezohen, te poshterohen, te ringrihen dhe te mbijetojne duke u mbeshtetur tek njera-tjetra! Nje histori mbijetese e disa vajzave te reja, ne nje bote te madhe, ku ato jane thjesht ”Lule” te vetmuara!

programme.title: Rudina
programme.desc: Një show argëtues dhe informativ nga Rudina Magjistari, që e shoqeron çdo pasdite familjet shqiptare me të ftuar të shumtë e VIP, por dhe njerez të e thjeshte me historitë e tyre personale.

programme.title: Aldo Morning Show
programme.desc: Dielli lind ndryshe në TVKLAN, në 7 pa 1 minutë! Të lodhur apo të palodhur nga gjumi i natës, nga e djeshmja me halle e strese, Aldo ju fton të zgjohemi me buzeqeshje, me qeshje, me nënqeshje, dhe më kryesorja. me një adrenaline të paparë për ta nisu.

programme.title: Shije Shtepie
programme.desc: Emision edukues, informues & argetues me zj.Vjollca dhe Katerina Trungu. Cdo ditë me recetat e thjeshta dhe mbi te gjitha ekonomike te Zj.Vjollca duke edukuar amvisat si te ushqehemi shëndetshëm. Rubrika te ndryshme me te ftuar speciale me këshilla te thjeshta praktike, të kuptueshme nga te gjithë, për cdo aspekt të të përditshmes. Argetim, me muzikë dhe quiz, lojëra gjithëperfshirëse qe te japin atë dëshirën për të luajtur dhe per te komunikuar live me Katerinen dhe te ftuarit e saj.

programme.title: Fiks fare
programme.desc: Programi i pare investigativ ne median shqiptare fokusuar ne korrupsionin e padrejtesite, trafikimin e abuzimet me pushtetin, problemet ekonomike, sociale si dhe hallet e ndryshme te njerezve. Fiks Fare trajton problematikat e qytetarëve, denoncon abuzimet, korrupsionin dhe shkeljet institucionale, duke i sjellë ato në vëmendjen e publikut dhe autoriteteve.

programme.title: Wake Up
programme.desc: Emisioni sjell një kombinim të lajmeve më të rëndësishme të ditës, analizave të aktualitetit, parashikimit të motit, informacioneve praktike, intervistave me të ftuar nga fusha të ndryshme, rubrikave të argëtimit dhe muzikës. Me një atmosferë dinamike dhe pozitive, synon t’i informojë dhe argëtojë teleshikuesit, duke u ofruar energjinë e duhur për nisjen e ditës.

programme.title: Në shtëpinë tonë
programme.desc: Në Shtëpinë Tonë” është emisioni i paradites në Top Channel, një hapësirë e ngrohtë ku bashkohen historia, emocionet, informacioni dhe argëtimi. Me personazhe të njohur e të zakonshëm, rrëfime që frymëzojnë, tema që prekin jetën familjare dhe këshilla praktike për përditshmërinë, programi bëhet pjesë e shtëpisë së çdo teleshikuesi. Në kuzhinë, receta të shijshme dhe ide të thjeshta gatimi sjellin çdo ditë shije dhe kreativitet.

programme.title: Lajme, moti
programme.desc: Lajmet kryesore të ditës nga vendi dhe bota.

programme.title: Shqipëria Live
programme.desc: Programi ku perfshihen te gjitha tematikat kryesore te momentit. Te ftuar te ndryshem, intervista ekskluzive, lidhje direkte dhe debat ne studio. Nje mbulim 360 grade i ngjarjeve ne kohe reale, gjithcka qe ndodh ne vendin tone. Nje nga shtyllat kryesore te programit eshte larmishmeria e perfshirjes te figurave te ndryshme qofte ne studio por edhe nga terreni. Nje program i përditshëm informativ dhe i aktualitetit, i cili sjell në qendër të vëmendjes ngjarjet më të rëndësishme të ditës.

programme.title: S0E3 - 6 Motrat
programme.desc: Në mes të dëshpërimit, motrat Silvia vendosin t’i gjejnë paratë në mënyrë jo ligjore. Gabrieli i ofron Fransiskës të këndojë te kafe-teatri ”Ambigu”.

programme.title: Ftesë në Pesë
programme.desc: Programi i pasdites në Top Channel, është një program sa informues aq edhe argëtues që ndërthur intervista, aktualitet, histori njerëzore dhe tema që prekin jetën e përditshme. Me të ftuar nga fusha të ndryshme, personazhe publike dhe njerëz me histori frymëzuese, programi sjell biseda të sinqerta, emocione, debat dhe këndvështrime të ndryshme mbi çështje sociale, kulturore dhe të aktualitetit, në një atmosferë të ngrohtë dhe komunikim të drejtpërdrejtë me publikun.

programme.title: Per’Puthen
programme.desc: Eshtë një program që vendos në qendër njohjet, flirtin dhe marrëdhëniet mes të rinjve që kërkojnë dashurinë. Djem dhe vajza, që njihen me njëri- tjetrin në ekran, për të përmbushur qëllimin e nje dashurie, të ndërtuar në sytë e publikut. Takimet, pëlqimet, xhelozitë, rivalitetet dhe debatet krijojnë dinamika të papritura, ndërsa historitë e personazheve zhvillohen natyrshëm përpara publikut.

Përmes intervistave ekskluzive, debateve me të ftuar, analizave dhe raportimeve të thelluara, programi ofron një pasqyrë të plotë të zhvillimeve që ndikojnë në jetën publike.

programme.desc: Chris Evans. Bazuar në romain best seller të ”New York Times”. Kur i biri adoleshent akuzohet për një krim që tronditi gjithë qytezën, prokurori Andi Barber detyrohet të zgjedhë mes betimit për të mbështetur drejtësinë dhe dashurisë së pakushtëzuar të një babai.

Me personazhe të njohur e të zakonshëm, rrëfime që frymëzojnë, tema që prekin jetën familjare dhe këshilla praktike për përditshmërinë, programi bëhet pjesë e shtëpisë së çdo teleshikuesi. Në kuzhinë, receta të shijshme dhe ide të thjeshta gatimi sjellin çdo ditë shije dhe kreativitet.

programme.title: Ftesë në Pesë
programme.desc: Programi i pasdites në Top Channel, është një program sa informues aq edhe argëtues që ndërthur intervista, aktualitet, histori njerëzore dhe tema që prekin jetën e përditshme. Me të ftuar nga fusha të ndryshme, personazhe publike dhe njerëz me histori frymëzuese, programi sjell biseda të sinqerta, emocione, debat dhe këndvështrime të ndryshme mbi çështje sociale, kulturore dhe të aktualitetit, në një atmosferë të ngrohtë dhe komunikim të drejtpërdrejtë me publikun.

programme.title: Per’Puthen
programme.desc: Eshtë një program që vendos në qendër njohjet, flirtin dhe marrëdhëniet mes të rinjve që kërkojnë dashurinë. Djem dhe vajza, që njihen me njëri- tjetrin në ekran, për të përmbushur qëllimin e nje dashurie, të ndërtuar në sytë e publikut. Takimet, pëlqimet, xhelozitë, rivalitetet dhe debatet krijojnë dinamika të papritura, ndërsa historitë e personazheve zhvillohen natyrshëm përpara publikut.

programme.desc: Curly Snaps/Preteen Scream: Curly gets enraged after a minor playground mix-up. He locks himself in the principal's office and refuses to come out. Phoebe has a secret crush on a pop star.

programme.desc: Stinky Goes Hollywood/Olga Gets Engaged: Stinky's simple life changes after he becomes the surprise new spokesman for Ya-Hoo Soda. Olga brings home her surprise fiancé who wins over everyone except Helga.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: While feeling the effects of laughing gas, Helga leaves a confessional message of love on Arnold's phone machine. / After Harold shoplifts some meat from the butcher shop, he is sentenced to work off his punishment.

programme.desc: Arnold accidentally breaks a promise he made to Iggy and must deal with the consequences. / Big Bob hires a nanny for Helga. Helga fights the nanny at her own game and forces her to leave.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: Arnold becomes a hot (and dangerous) hitter. He keeps injuring people every time he swings the bat. Afraid of hurting more people, Arnold refuses to play ball. / Arnold and Gerald manage the career of the unlikely country-and-western singer, Mr. Hyunh.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: Arnold lends Sid his room for one evening, but the arrangement backfires when Sid keeps on borrowing the room. / Helga and Patty (the big girl) face off.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: All the kids are paired with adults with interesting jobs except Arnold, who is forced to spend time with the Jolly Olly Man. / Harold believes it's his life's calling to become a butcher, but he slowly drives Mr. Greene, the butcher, crazy.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: Casa Paradiso/Gerald''s Tonsils: Grandpa becomes tired of dealing with the boarding house and decides to sell./Gerald has his tonsils removed before a big concert and must come to grips with the fact that his voice has changed.

programme.sub-title: Phoebe Takes the Fall/The Pig War
programme.desc: Phoebe Takes the Fall/The Pig War: Phoebe agrees to take a dive so that Helga can win a competition./The boys engage in a recreation of a historical battle, only this time their prized pig is in danger of losing his life.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: Best Man/Cool Party: The Coach wants to remarry Tish and asks Arnold to be his best man./ Rhonda has a party and only invites the cool kids.

programme.desc: Sid''s Revenge/Roller Coaster: After Arnold accidentally embarrasses Sid, Sid seeks revenge./ Eugene wants to ride with the gang, but they all think he''s a jinx and won''t go with him.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: Grandpa's Birthday/Road Trip: Grandpa thinks he's going to die soon because no one in his family ever made it past his age. He prepares to die, and Arnold tries to convince him that life is still worth living.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: Arnold and Lila/Grand Prix: Helga, lost in a love reverie, writes "Arnold loves Helga" on a wall, but changes the name to "Lila" when the kids approach. Lila thinks that Arnold loves her until he explains the mistake.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: Girl Trouble/School Dance: Arnold tells Grandpa he''s tired of dealing with Helga''s nonsense. Grandpa tells Arnold a story about a girl he had to deal with when he was a kid who treated him the same way. She turns out to be Grandma.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: Helga's Show/Flood: Helga does a standup routine at a school function and proceeds to insult all of her friends. They are offended, prompting her to change her act to a more friendly and gentle routine. She performs the new act, but it's boring.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: Arnold and Helga perform a \"Romeo and Juliet\"- type play for a school production

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: At the Parent's Day competition, Arnold learns that even though he doesn't have \"real\" parents, his grandparents are just as good as everyone else's parents.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!: The Headless Cabbie/Friday the 13th

programme.title: Hey Arnold!: Weird Cousin/Baby Oskar

programme.title: Hey Arnold!: Helga Sleepwalks/Fighting Families

programme.title: A l'ombre de la guillotine

programme.title: Le Noël des insectes
programme.desc: Une décoration de Noël représentant le Père Noël descend d'un sapin décoré et se rend dans la forêt. Là, il crée et décore un sapin de Noël pour les animaux de la forêt. Il invite ensuite tous les animaux, à venir profiter des cadeaux qu'il a préparés et à fêter Noël.

programme.title: The Lonely Trail

programme.title: Mesa of Lost Women

programme.title: Bigamie

programme.title: The tuba tooter

programme.desc: Adaptation italienne de l'oeuvre de Shakespeare. Battista a deux filles : la douce Bianca et Catina, qui refuse farouchement de se marier, et surtout pas à Petruccio Belli, de retour d'Amérique.

programme.title: Fantômas contre Fantômas

programme.title: Hallelujah

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Tensions between Krystle and Blake mount as their suspicions of one another grow. Claudia regrets sleeping with Adam. Dominique derails Alexis' attempt to buy out her company but is unable to stop Brady's divorce proceedings.

programme.title: Dynasty

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis is relieved and Blake is concerned when Amanda suddenly changes her mind and decides to marry Prince Michael. Sammy Jo is revealed to be the culprit behind the compromising photographs.

programme.title: Dynasty

programme.title: Dynasty

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Dex tells a devastated Krystle that Daniel Reece is dead. Steven is outraged when Sammy Jo decides to fight for custody of her son in court. Jeff proposes marriage to Ashley. Sammy Jo learns that her monies will be held in trust with Krystle as executor.

programme.desc: Elena confesses to Amanda that nothing happened in the bedroom with Prince Michael. Sammy Jo fits her roommate Rita with a blonde wig and has her practice duplicating Krystle's voice. Fallon has chosen a new name and heads for Denver.

programme.title: Mister Rogers' Neighborhood

programme.title: Mister Rogers' Neighborhood
programme.desc: Marilyn Barnett stops by for some sitting down exercises. Prince Tuesday asks Handyman Negri to help bring his ragdoll to life. Corney has made a new (imaginary) umbrella Rockit for Daniel's imaginary friend, Malcolm Apricot Dinko.

programme.sub-title: It's hard to learn new things

programme.title: Mister Rogers' Neighborhood

programme.title: Mister Rogers' Neighborhood

programme.title: Mister Rogers' Neighborhood

programme.title: Dr. House

programme.title: Dr. House
programme.desc: Bei der Untersuchung des kleinen Jackson (Dominic Scott) entdecken die Ärzte, dass er ein Zwitter ist, also halb Junge, halb Mädchen. Überhaupt ist der Miesepeter neuerdings sowohl zu ihnen als auch zu den Patienten auffäl

programme.title: Dr. House

programme.title: Dr. House
programme.desc: Altenpflegerin Morgan glaubt, dass eine Katze den Tod vorausahnt, und ist in heller Aufregung, weil sich das Tier auch zu ihr ins Bett gelegt hat. Für House (Hugh Laurie) ist das natürlich Unfug. Als Morgan schwer erkrankt, muss er den Fall aber ernst nehmen.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Ein Bekannter von Joans Schwester bittet die Detektive um Hilfe, denn seine Internet-Freundin Maria ist wie vom Erdboden verschluckt. Wurde sie entführt? Bei den Ermittlungen stellen Joan und Sherlock fest, dass Maria ihren Lebensunterhalt damit verdient hat, dass sie sich von Online-Verehrern mit Gutscheinen überhäufen ließ. Hatte einer ihrer Verehrer genug von der Vereinbarung?
